CreateSubscriptionRequest.description:
Request payload for creating a new subscription

This struct represents the data required to create a new subscription in the system.
It includes details about the product, quantity, customer information, and billing details.

payment_link.description:
If true, generates a payment link.
Defaults to false if not specified.

product_id.description: Unique identifier of the product to subscribe to

quantity.description: Number of units to subscribe for. Must be at least 1.

return_url.description: Optional URL to redirect after successful subscription creation

trial_period_days.description:
Optional trial period in days
If specified, this value overrides the trial period set in the product's price
Must be between 0 and 10000 days

client_secret.description:
Client secret used to load Dodo checkout SDK
NOTE : Dodo checkout SDK will be coming soon

amount.description: The amount involved in the dispute, represented as a string to accommodate precision.

business_id.description: Unique identifier for the business to which the product belongs.

image.description: URL of the product image, optional.

is_recurring.description: Indicates if the product is recurring (e.g., subscriptions).

license_key_activation_message.description: Message sent upon license key activation, if applicable.

license_key_activations_limit.description: Limit on the number of activations for the license key, if enabled.

license_key_enabled.description: Indicates whether the product requires a license key.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

business_id.description: Unique identifier for the business to which the product belongs.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

image.description: URL of the product image, optional.

is_recurring.description: Indicates if the product is recurring (e.g., subscriptions).

price.description:
Price of the product, optional.

The price is represented in the lowest denomination of the currency.
For example:
- In USD, a price of `$12.34` would be represented as `1234` (cents).
- In JPY, a price of `¥1500` would be represented as `1500` (yen).
- In INR, a price of `₹1234.56` would be represented as `123456` (paise).

This ensures precision and avoids floating-point rounding errors.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

activations_limit.description: The maximum number of activations allowed for this license key.

business_id.description: The unique identifier of the business associated with the license key.

created_at.description: The timestamp indicating when the license key was created, in UTC.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer associated with the license key.

expires_at.description: The timestamp indicating when the license key expires, in UTC.

id.description: The unique identifier of the license key.

instances_count.description: The current number of instances activated for this license key.

payment_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment associated with the license key.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product associated with the license key.

subscription_id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription associated with the license key, if any.

discount.description: Discount applied to the price, represented as a percentage (0 to 100).

price.description:
The payment amount. Represented in the lowest denomination of the currency (e.g., cents for USD).
For example, to charge $1.00, pass `100`.

purchasing_power_parity.description:
Indicates if purchasing power parity adjustments are applied to the price.
Purchasing power parity feature is not available as of now

tax_inclusive.description: Indicates if the price is tax inclusive

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the event occurred (not necessarily the same of when it was delivered)

activations_limit.description:
The updated activation limit for the license key.
Use `null` to remove the limit, or omit this field to leave it unchanged.

disabled.description:
Indicates whether the license key should be disabled.
A value of `true` disables the key, while `false` enables it. Omit this field to leave it unchanged.

expires_at.description:
The updated expiration timestamp for the license key in UTC.
Use `null` to remove the expiration date, or omit this field to leave it unchanged.

description.description: Description of the product, optional and must be at most 1000 characters.

license_key_activation_message.description:
Message sent to the customer upon license key activation.

Only applicable if `license_key_enabled` is `true`. This message contains instructions for
activating the license key.

license_key_activations_limit.description:
Limit for the number of activations for the license key.

Only applicable if `license_key_enabled` is `true`. Represents the maximum number of times
the license key can be activated.

license_key_enabled.description:
Whether the product requires a license key.

If `true`, additional fields related to license key (duration, activations limit, activation message)
become applicable.

name.description: Name of the product, optional and must be at most 100 characters.

refunds.description: List of refunds issued for this payment

subscription_id.description: Identifier of the subscription if payment is part of a subscription

tax.description: Amount of tax collected in smallest currency unit (e.g. cents)

payout_id.description: The unique identifier of the payout.

refunds.description: The total value of refunds associated with the payout.

remarks.description: Any additional remarks or notes associated with the payout.

discount.description: Discount applied to the price, represented as a percentage (0 to 100).

Number of units for the payment frequency.
For example, a value of `1` with a `payment_frequency_interval` of `month` represents monthly payments.

price.description:
The payment amount. Represented in the lowest denomination of the currency (e.g., cents for USD).
For example, to charge $1.00, pass `100`.

purchasing_power_parity.description:
Indicates if purchasing power parity adjustments are applied to the price.
Purchasing power parity feature is not available as of now

subscription_period_count.description:
Number of units for the subscription period.

tax_inclusive.description: Indicates if the price is tax inclusive

trial_period_days.description: Number of days for the trial period. A value of `0` indicates no trial period.
